source.source_text: Purpose: focus an allowlisted running app/window by normalized identity. Input: app_id:string, window_hint?:string. Output: resolved app/window and focus verification. Contract: L3 writes_local; scope mac.app.control; target app_window; timeout 10000ms; cap 128KiB; no network/filesystem; sensitive/system-security targets denied; approval trusted_app_control; operation may be repeated safely after re-resolution. Phase 4 planned.
